data.insight: The only missing daemon behavior the installed janitors actually consume is parked state for the steward plus PTY effective working state for board/idle; disk-health and dashboard history are useful features but not current janitor call dependencies.
data.quote_text: T776 · lab-hermes5. Need your timer→call→patch inventory; sol-b has none. Here is what I derived rea...
data.text:
Verified against installed units/scripts and the trees just now. Your derived map is essentially correct; corrections/details below.

Timer → call → endpoint → patch
- `cccc-worktree-steward.timer` → `/usr/local/sbin/cccc-worktree-steward` → argv `[CCCC,"actor","list","--group",gid]` → daemon op `actor_list`; needs `parked`/`parked_reason` in rows. Missing on installed 0.4.43 (`actor list` shows 9 rows, 0 parked keys). Patch: `origin/t077/rs13-impl` @db4f184b (+523/-94 across 10 files); merge-base vs `upstream/main` is `0d73fced`, so treat as needing a -q043 port unless you verify otherwise. It also calls argv `[CCCC,"send","--group",gid,"--by",foreman,"--to",foreman,"--mode","mail",text]` → daemon op `send`/`message_send`; stock provides it.
- `cccc-tmp-reaper.timer` → `/usr/local/sbin/cccc-tmp-reaper` → argv `[CCCC,"send","--group",GROUP,"--by",BY,"--to",REPORT_TO,"--mode","mail",text]` → `send`; stock provides it.
- `cccc-disk-watch.timer` → `/usr/local/sbin/cccc-disk-watch` → argv `[CCCC,"send","--group",GROUP,"--by",BY,"--to","user","--mode","send",msg]` → `send`; stock provides it.
- `cccc-disk-growth-alarm.timer` → `/usr/local/sbin/cccc-disk-growth-alarm` → argv `[CCCC,"send","--group",GROUP,"--by",BY,"--to",TO,"--mode","mail",msg]` → `send`; also invokes `cwf reap --apply --cache-max-age-hours 0.5 --config /srv/CWF/cwf/deploy/reap/firestar.toml` on breach. Stock cccc provides `send`; no janitor currently calls `ping.disk`/`disk_events`. `fix/daemon-home-disk-health-561d` is therefore not required by these timers as installed; it is the T773 daemon feature.
- `cccc-cache-clean.timer` → `/usr/local/sbin/cccc-cache-clean`; no cccc call.
- `cccc-lane-census.timer` → `python3 /srv/CWF/cwf/deploy/lane-census/cccc-lane-census.py --state /var/lib/cccc/lane-census-state.json --sample-seconds 10`; no daemon RPC in normal operation (it reads `/proc`, CCCC_HOME group.yaml, runtime config); no cccc patch required.
- `cwf-reap.timer` → `/usr/local/bin/cwf reap --apply --config ...` then `/usr/local/bin/cwf reap --all-groups --apply`. `--all-groups` uses `CCCCClient.groups()` → daemon groups listing; stock provides it. Built-in daemon `tick_leftovers`/`tick_actor_memory` are separate: `crates/cccc-daemon/src/ops/leftover.rs` absent on 953ad1fa and rides `fix/leftover-process-monitor` family; `actor_memory.rs` rides the T474 memory patch family (`fix/t474-memory-ceiling-rebased` @07caa21e or the q043 counterpart you choose).
- `cwf-idle.timer` → `/usr/local/bin/cwf idle --apply --config /srv/CWF/cwf/deploy/idle/firestar.toml`; uses `CCCCClient.groups()` and actor/message calls; stock endpoints are present, but PTY effective working state needs pty-liveness.
- `cwf-tick.timer`, `cwf-pm-tick.timer`, `cwf-board@*.timer` → `cwf board ...`; uses `group_show`, `actor_list` (`include_unread` in cwf), `context_get`, `tracked_send`, and `send`. The observed `cwf-board@g_819ab6ffb46b` failure is `send notice → invalid_recipient: wick-foreman`, cwf-side T616 (fixed on cwf `d3f3ff3`), not a missing cccc endpoint.

Missing-on-953ad1fa confirmations
- `crates/cccc-runtime/src/activity.rs` absent: yes. `pty-liveness` is CONFLICT-043 in patches.list; `origin/oc1/pty-liveness-q043` exists and should be the port candidate.
- `parked`/`parked_reason` absent from live actor_list: yes. Patch `origin/t077/rs13-impl`, q043 port needed.
- `crates/cccc-daemon/src/ops/leftover.rs` absent on stock 953ad1fa: yes. `fix/leftover-process-monitor-5c297aef` is the queue-adjacent family; verify whether you want the full local `fix/leftover-process-monitor` stack rather than only the 5c297aef tip.
- `crates/cccc-daemon/src/disk_health.rs` absent: yes; T773.

`fix/group-worktrees`: no — it is not `origin/fix/group-worktrees` here. I see only local branch `fix/group-worktrees` @037489e0 (`wip(daemon): group worktrees view and safe cleanup engine`, 7 files, +1593), no `origin/` ref, and its merge-base with `upstream/main` is `561d94f2`, i.e. an older lab stack, not bare 953ad1fa. It is not the current steward's call path (the installed script uses actor_list + send), so I would not select it for the janitor endpoint mapping without a separate seat ruling.
